name: Cargo Distribution — Feasibility Probe
summary: Development probe for arrival-based cargo unloading. Test saves only.
description: Version 0.1.1-prototype. Opt in by naming one test line Cst CD PROBE. Stop 2 attempts to unload 50% of arrival cargo; stop 3 attempts to unload 100%. This is an instrumented experiment, not a validated gameplay release. Rename the line Cst CD RESET and let the simulation run before removing. Read README.md and TESTING.md. Author credit and licensing must be selected before publication.
